name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__add_booking_attendee
description: Add a new attendee to an existing booking. Required: name, email, timeZone. ASK THE USER for all attendee details — never guess or fabricate names, emails, or time zones.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__assign_attribute_to_user
description: Assign an attribute option to a user. For SINGLE_SELECT/MULTI_SELECT attributes, pass attributeOptionId (use get_attribute_options to list available options). For TEXT/NUMBER attributes, pass value instead to create an option on the fly. Optionally set a weight for round-robin routing.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__calculate_routing_form_slots
description: Submit a routing form response and get available slots. The response object contains the user's answers (keys are routing form field slugs/IDs). Use get_org_routing_forms (organization admins) or get_team_routing_forms (team admins) to find routingFormId. Start/end must be in UTC ISO 8601.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__call_api_operation
description: Call any Cal.com API v2 operation by operationId with arguments shaped by describe_api_operation. Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists. Confirm with the user before calling operations that create, change or delete data.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__cancel_booking
description: Cancel a booking by UID. For recurring non-seated bookings, set cancelSubsequentBookings=true to cancel future recurrences. For seated bookings, pass seatUid to cancel a specific seat instead of the entire booking. Confirm with the user before cancelling.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__confirm_booking
description: Confirm a pending booking that requires manual confirmation. Only the host can confirm.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__confirm_booking_seats
description: Confirm selected pending seats on a confirmation-required seated booking. Pass seatUids from the booking. POST /bookings/{bookingUid}/confirm refuses these bookings.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_booking
description: Create a booking. WORKFLOW: (1) Use get_event_types to find the event type ID/slug. (2) Call get_availability to find open slots — NEVER pick a time without checking availability first. (3) If using bookingFieldsResponses, call get_event_type first to discover required custom fields. (4) For attendee details (name, email, timeZone), use get_me if booking for yourself, otherwise ASK THE USER — never guess or fabricate attendee info. Identify the event type by: eventTypeId, OR eventTypeSlug + username (individual), OR eventTypeSlug + teamSlug (team). The 'start' time MUST be in UTC ISO 8601. 'username' is the HOST whose calendar you are booking. 'attendee' is the GUEST (the caller).

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_event_type
description: Create a new event type. Required: title, slug, lengthInMinutes. Supports locations, booking fields, buffers, recurrence, confirmation policy, seats, and more.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_org_membership
description: Add a user to an organization or invite by email. WORKFLOW: (1) To invite by email, pass 'email' and 'role'. (2) To attach by user ID, pass 'userId' and 'role'. Provide userId OR email, not both. Invites may auto-accept or remain pending based on org settings. Platform managed users should only have MEMBER role.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_routing_form
description: Create a routing form for a team in an organization, from a name and an optional description. Confirm the name and the team with the user before calling; use get_my_teams or get_org_teams to find teamId and never guess it. Each call creates a new form, so never call it again to retry or to rename a form. The form starts with no questions and one fallback route, and is returned with its id, routes and updatedAt. To change its routes, pass the returned routes and updatedAt straight to edit_routing_form_routes, and don't call get_routing_form right after creating the form, because it can briefly miss a new form. This tool does not add questions, and until the form has questions the only route change that applies is setFallback.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_schedule
description: Create a schedule. Required: name, timeZone, isDefault. Each user should have exactly one default schedule. Supports availability slots and date-specific overrides.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_team_invite
description: Generate an invite link for a team. Returns a URL that can be shared with users to join the team.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__create_team_membership
description: Add a user to a team. Required: userId (must be a real user ID from the system). Optional: role (defaults to MEMBER), accepted, disableImpersonation. accepted: true is applied only to an accepted member of the parent organization or a managed user of the team's OAuth client; anyone else is added as a pending invite they have to accept. Ask the user for the userId — never guess.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__decline_booking_seats
description: Decline selected seats on a confirmation-required seated booking. Waiting and confirmed seats can be declined. Pass seatUids from the booking. An optional reason is stored on each declined seat. POST /bookings/{bookingUid}/decline refuses these bookings.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__delete_event_type
description: Permanently delete an event type by ID. This action is irreversible — confirm with the user before proceeding.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__delete_org_membership
description: Remove a membership from an organization. This action is irreversible — confirm with the user before proceeding.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__delete_schedule
description: Delete a schedule by its numeric ID. This action is irreversible, confirm with the user before proceeding.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__delete_team_membership
description: Remove a user from a team. This action is irreversible — confirm with the user before proceeding. Use get_team_memberships to find the membershipId — never guess.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__describe_api_operation
description: Get the full input schema of an API v2 operation before calling it with call_api_operation.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__duplicate_event_type
description: Duplicate an organization team event type into the same team or another team of the same organization. Find the source with get_event_types or get_event_type and never guess ids: teamId is the source's team and orgId its organization (get_me). Before calling, confirm with the user the target team (targetTeamId; use get_my_teams or get_org_teams to find it), the new title and the new slug, which must not be used in the target team; a 409 means the slug is taken, so ask for another. description and lengthInMinutes default to the source's. A copy in another team leaves out hosts who are not accepted members of the target team and activates none of the source's workflows: tell the user which ones were dropped, from droppedHostUserIds and droppedWorkflowIds. When destinationCalendarDropped is true, the copy was created without the source's destination calendar because the caller cannot set it (they are not a host of the copy, or the calendar is another member's connection): tell the user, so a host can set it. Duplicating into a team of another organization, or a team outside any organization, is refused with 400.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__edit_routing_form_fields
description: Edit the questions of an existing team routing form: add, update or remove questions. Call get_routing_form first and refer to existing questions by the fieldId it returns and to their options by option id; a label only names a new question, and ids are never guessed. Send only the operations that change something: every route and every untouched question keeps its id and settings, and an update changes only the properties it lists. To change a choice question's options, send its complete option list in display order: keep each existing option's id (a renamed option keeps its id, so routes comparing against it keep matching), omit the id for a new option, and leave an option out to remove it. A question's type can't be changed; remove it and add a new one. Position is 0-based among the form's questions, and add appends when it is omitted. Always preview first with dryRun: true (the default), show the user the returned changes and warnings, and get their confirmation. Then send the same operations with dryRun: false and expectedUpdatedAt set to the updatedAt from the preview. A 409 means the form changed after the preview: call get_routing_form again, rebuild and preview the edit, and ask for confirmation again; never retry an apply blindly. Removing a question or an option that a route uses (on this form or on a form that routes through it) is rejected with 400: change or remove that route first with edit_routing_form_routes. A hidden question is not shown to the booker and takes its answer from a URL parameter named after its identifier, e.g. a hidden "Lead Source" filled in by the link the lead clicked; a hidden question can't be required. Renaming a question without an explicit identifier changes the key prefilled links use; the preview warns when that happens.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__edit_routing_form_routes
description: Edit the routes of an existing team routing form: add, replace, remove or move routes, or change the fallback. Call get_routing_form first, refer to routes by the routeId it returns and to questions by their exact label, and never guess ids. Send only the operations that change something, never the full routes array: untouched routes keep their ids and settings. Always preview first with dryRun: true (the default), show the user the returned changes and warnings, and get their confirmation. Then send the same operations with dryRun: false and expectedUpdatedAt set to the updatedAt from the preview. A 409 means the form changed after the preview: call get_routing_form again, rebuild and preview the edit, and ask for confirmation again; never retry an apply blindly. Routes are evaluated top to bottom and the first match wins, so put the most specific routes first (position is 0-based among non-fallback routes; add appends when omitted). Multiselect questions have no equals: all_in means every selected option is in the list, so it is a subset test. An unanswered optional question counts as empty, and an empty value matches not_equals, not_contains, not_all_in, less_than, less_or_equal and ends_with; make the question required, or route on a choice question with explicit options, when that would catch the wrong people. Number questions support only equals, not_equals, greater_than, less_than, greater_or_equal, less_or_equal and between; use non-overlapping ranges. Router routes can be moved or removed but not replaced. Change the fallback only with setFallback. On a route to a round-robin event type, memberFilter limits the hosts to team members whose attributes match, and fallbackMemberFilter (same shape) sets the hosts used when memberFilter matches nobody. Fallback rules need attribute rules on the route: send memberFilter too, or replace a route that already has them. A route whose own fallback action (set in the route builder, not the form fallback that setFallback changes) shows a message or redirects to a URL never uses fallback rules, so the edit is refused. On replace, omitting memberFilter or fallbackMemberFilter keeps the stored rules; get_routing_form only counts them in its summary, so omit them rather than rebuilding rules you cannot read. Attach examples (answers keyed by question label, and the expectedRoute they must reach: a route id, route name or event-type slug, or null for the fallback) so the server checks that the edited routes catch the intended answers; a failed example rejects the edit with 400.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__find_api_operation
description: Search the Cal.com API v2 catalog for operations not covered by a dedicated tool. Returns operationIds to pass to describe_api_operation and call_api_operation.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_app_link
description: Build a URL that opens the relevant page in the Cal.com web app so the user can review or edit something in the dashboard. Use it whenever you show the user a booking, event type, schedule, team, routing form or setting — people want a link, not a description. Returns the URL; do not fabricate URLs yourself.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_attribute_options
description: List all available options for a SINGLE_SELECT or MULTI_SELECT attribute. Returns option IDs and values needed when assigning attributes to users via assign_attribute_to_user.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_availability
description: Get available time slots for a host. You MUST provide at least one identifier: (1) eventTypeId, (2) eventTypeSlug + username, (3) eventTypeSlug + teamSlug, or (4) usernames (comma-separated, min 2, for dynamic events). 'username' is the host whose availability you are checking. Start/end must be in UTC ISO 8601.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_booking
description: Get a specific booking by its UID (use get_bookings to find UIDs). Returns full details including attendees, location, and metadata.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_booking_attendee
description: Get a specific attendee by their numeric ID within a booking. Use get_booking_attendees to find attendee IDs.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_booking_attendees
description: Get all attendees for a booking by its UID.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_booking_routing_trace
description: Get the routing trace for a booking — the step-by-step decision path showing how the booking was routed (routing form evaluation, CRM lookups, host selection). Returns human-readable steps grouped by round, plus the routing form submission answers. Only available for bookings that completed routing (permanent traces). Use get_bookings to find booking UIDs.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_bookings
description: List bookings with pagination (default 100, max 250 per page — use take/skip for more). By default returns only bookings the authenticated user participates in (organizer, host, or attendee); pass scope='all' to include every booking the API key/token can see (useful for admins viewing org-wide bookings). Supports filtering by status (upcoming, recurring, past, cancelled, unconfirmed), attendee email/name, event type, team, date ranges (afterStart, beforeEnd), and sorting (sortStart, sortEnd, sortCreated).

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_busy_times
description: Get busy/blocked time blocks from a connected calendar (e.g. Google Calendar) between two dates. Returns a list of time ranges when the user is unavailable. Required: dateFrom, dateTo (YYYY-MM-DD), credentialId, and externalId. WORKFLOW: (1) Call get_connected_calendars first to get the real credentialId (number) and externalId (e.g. email) for the calendar — NEVER guess or fabricate these. (2) Provide dateFrom and dateTo as YYYY-MM-DD strings. (3) Optionally pass timeZone (IANA, e.g. 'America/New_York') to localise the results.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_conferencing_apps
description: List all conferencing applications connected to the authenticated user's account (e.g. Zoom, Google Meet, Cal Video).

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_connected_calendars
description: List all calendar integrations connected to the authenticated user's account. Returns each calendar's credentialId and externalId, which are required by get_busy_times. Also shows the user's destination calendar.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_crm_sync_errors
description: List CRM sync errors for an event type and CRM app slug, such as salesforce. By default returns active/current errors only; set includeDismissed=true to include dismissed historical errors. Use eventTypeId plus appSlug, not credentialId. Supports cursor pagination via limit (1-100, default 50) and cursor. Requires read access to the event type.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_default_schedule
description: Get the authenticated user's default schedule.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_event
description: Get one Cal Event (a fixed-date RSVP page served at cal.com/{slug}) by its uuid. Not for event types (use get_event_type with a numeric id) or calendar events. Use this when you already have the Event's uuid; otherwise call get_events first and never guess the uuid. An Event the user cannot access returns 404, the same as one that does not exist.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_event_type
description: Get a specific event type by its numeric ID or UUID (use get_event_types to find IDs). Returns full details including locations, booking fields, and schedule.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_event_type_history
description: Get the audit history (change log) for an event type by ID (use get_event_types to find IDs). Returns audit log entries showing what changed, who made the change, when, and the previous/new field values, ordered most recent first. Supports cursor pagination via limit (1-50, default 25) and cursor. Requires audit-history access to the event type — general read access alone is not sufficient.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_event_type_settings
description: Get the full event type settings as exposed by the Cal.com API — including scheduling type, hosts, locations, booking fields, limits, and all other configuration. For org-scoped team event types, pass orgId + teamId.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_event_types
description: List event types. Without parameters returns all event types for the authenticated user. Pass 'username' to list another user's event types, or username + eventSlug for a specific one. Use usernames (comma-separated) for dynamic group event types.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_events
description: List the authenticated user's Cal Events: fixed-date RSVP pages served at cal.com/{slug}, such as a workshop or meetup that guests register for. Events are NOT event types (bookable meeting templates; use get_event_types) and NOT calendar events or bookings. Use this when the user asks about their Events or RSVP pages, or to find an Event's uuid for get_event. Returns Events the user owns or co-hosts, newest start time first; team-owned Events they do not host are not included. Supports limit (1-250, default 50) and filtering by slug; when pagination.hasMore is true, pass pagination.nextCursor as cursor to fetch the next page.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_me
description: Get the authenticated user's profile including username, email, time zone, default schedule, and organizationId. Call this first when you need the user's own details (email, username, organizationId) for other tools.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_my_teams
description: List teams the authenticated user belongs to. Supports take/skip pagination (take max 250). Works for any org member (org admins see all teams). Use get_me to obtain your organizationId. Returns team IDs, names, and slugs needed by other team-scoped tools.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_attribute
description: Get a single organization attribute by ID. Use get_org_attributes to find attribute IDs and get_attribute_options to list available options.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_attributes
description: List all attributes defined for an organization. Attributes are custom fields (TEXT, NUMBER, SINGLE_SELECT, MULTI_SELECT) used to tag members for routing and round-robin. Supports pagination with skip/take.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_membership
description: Get a specific organization membership by its numeric ID.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_memberships
description: List all memberships in an organization. Supports pagination with take/skip (take max 250).

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_routing_form_responses
description: Get responses for a specific routing form. Supports filtering by date ranges, routed booking UID, and sorting.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_routing_forms
description: List routing forms for an organization. Supports filtering by team IDs, date ranges, routed booking UID, and sorting.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_team_bookings
description: List all bookings for a team within an organization. Requires TEAM_ADMIN role. Supports filtering by status (upcoming, recurring, past, cancelled, unconfirmed), attendee email/name, event type, date ranges (afterStart, beforeEnd, afterCreatedAt, beforeCreatedAt, afterUpdatedAt, beforeUpdatedAt), and sorting (sortStart, sortEnd, sortCreated, sortUpdatedAt).

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_teams
description: List all teams in an organization. Supports take/skip pagination (take max 250). Requires ORG_ADMIN role. Use get_me to obtain your organizationId. Returns team IDs, names, and slugs needed by other team-scoped tools. If this fails with 403, use get_my_teams instead.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_org_user_bookings
description: List all bookings for a specific user within an organization. Requires ORG_ADMIN role. Use get_org_memberships to find user IDs. Supports filtering by status, attendee email/name, event type, team, date ranges, and sorting.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_routing_form
description: Get one team routing form: its questions (id, label, identifier, type, required, hidden, options) and its routes in evaluation order (id, name, kind, action, readable conditions). Call this before changing a form's routes or questions: route edits reference the route ids and question labels returned here, question edits reference the question and option ids, and applying an edit requires the form's updatedAt. Use get_team_routing_forms to find routingFormId; never guess route, question or option ids.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_routing_form_history
description: Get the change history of a team routing form, newest first: each entry has an id, a timestamp, who made the change, and what changed (questions, routes, route conditions and settings, with before and after values). Use it to see what changed on a form and when, and to review its recent changes before and after editing it with edit_routing_form_routes; a new edit can take a few seconds to appear. Use get_team_routing_forms to find routingFormId. Supports cursor pagination: limit (1-50, default 25) and cursor set to pagination.nextCursor.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_schedule
description: Get a schedule by its numeric ID. Returns availability slots and overrides.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_schedules
description: List all schedules of the authenticated user.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_scheduling_config
description: Get the scheduling configuration for a team event type. For roundRobin types: returns hosts (with priority, weight, mandatory status, group assignment), host groups, distribution settings (maxLeadThreshold), and advanced settings (weights enabled, no-show calculation, CRM fallback). For collective/managed types: returns hosts with basic info and assignAllTeamMembers. The event type must be a team event type — returns 422 otherwise.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_team_membership
description: Get a specific team membership by its numeric ID. Use get_team_memberships to find this — never guess.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_team_memberships
description: List all memberships in a team. Supports pagination with take/skip (take max 250) and filtering by up to 20 email addresses.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_team_routing_forms
description: List routing forms that belong to a team in an organization. Use this as a team admin; get_org_routing_forms requires an organization admin. Use get_my_teams or get_org_teams to find teamId. Supports filtering by name (case-insensitive substring) and disabled status, created/updated date range filters, sorting by created/updated date, and skip/take pagination. Use get_routing_form with a returned id to read its questions and routes.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_user_attribute_history
description: Get the attribute assignment history (audit log) for a user within an organization. Returns a chronological log of attribute assignment changes (assigned, updated, unassigned). Supports pagination with limit (1-50) and cursor. Requires org admin role.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__get_user_attributes
description: Get all attribute options assigned to a specific user within an organization. Returns grouped attributes with their assigned option values and weights.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__mark_booking_absent
description: Mark host or attendees as absent for a past booking. Set host=true if the host was absent. Use get_booking_attendees to look up real attendee emails before calling this.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__reschedule_booking
description: Reschedule a booking to a new time. WORKFLOW: (1) Call get_availability to find open slots — NEVER pick a new time without checking availability first. (2) The new start time must be in UTC ISO 8601. rescheduledBy is only needed for confirmation-required bookings — use the event owner's email (from get_me) for auto-confirmation. Never fabricate emails.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__search_docs
description: Search the Cal.com product documentation and return the most relevant pages with an excerpt of the top hit. Use when the user asks how a feature works or how to set something up.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__unassign_attribute_from_user
description: Remove an attribute option assignment from a user. Use get_user_attributes to find the attributeOptionId. Confirm with the user before proceeding.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__update_event_type
description: Update an existing event type by ID (use get_event_types to find IDs). Any provided field replaces the current value. Array fields (locations, bookingFields) replace entirely — fetch the current event type first with get_event_type to avoid losing existing values.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__update_me
description: Update the authenticated user's profile. Supports name, email, bio, time zone, week start, time format, default schedule, locale, avatar URL, and custom metadata.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__update_org_membership
description: Update an organization membership. Can change role, accepted status, or impersonation settings.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__update_schedule
description: Update an existing schedule. Array fields (availability, overrides) replace all existing entries.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__update_team_membership
description: Update a team membership. Can change accepted status, role, or impersonation settings. accepted: true on a pending membership is allowed only for an accepted member of the parent organization or a managed user of the team's OAuth client; otherwise it returns 403. Use get_team_memberships to find the membershipId — never guess.

name: mcp__claude_ai_Cal_com__update_user_attribute
description: Update an existing attribute assignment for a user (e.g. change the weight). Use get_user_attributes to find the attributeOptionId.
